capsuleTopic.title: Binding of Isaac
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Promise · son · test · Moriah · halt · provision · memory
capsuleTopic.orientation: Enter Genesis 22:1–19 as one Event told in nine reading movements. Earlier family Scenes set the promise and two sons in view. Later sources remember the Event through testing, compassion, faith, works, and resurrection reasoning.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow promise, relationship, command, journey, question, altar, interruption, provision, oath, return, and later memory without supplying Isaac’s unrecorded age, consent, emotions, or final movements.
